card.name: First number before a range dash
card.fires_on: A number that starts a range and is about to be followed by a dash, "to" or "through". Seen in day ranges of dosing schedules, page ranges and verse or date ranges.

modes.label: Dosing day ranges
modes.description: The day number after "Days" in a dosing schedule, before "to" or "through".

modes.label: Page, verse and date ranges
modes.description: The first number of a page, verse or date span, before a hyphen.

modes.label: Citation lists
modes.description: A reference number in a bracketed citation, before a comma or dash.

card.writes: It promotes hyphen and dash characters, so the model predicts a range dash after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the first number of a range, like Days 1 to 3 or pages 7-15, where a dash comes next.
